tagline: Bass-line pattern generator with a built-in bass synth
description: Generates a 4-bar bass pattern over a fixed I-IV-V-I progression in one of seven styles and plays it with its own synth, looped in time with the host transport. It ignores incoming MIDI and outputs no MIDI; the Export MIDI button saves the pattern as a .mid file. Settings are not saved with the project.

features.name: Seven Styles
features.description: Rock, Funk, Jazz, EDM, Reggae, Latin and Blues are rule-based patterns of roots, fifths and chord tones, with small random timing and velocity changes on all but EDM.

features.name: Key, Scale and Octave
features.description: Choose the root key, major or minor (which only changes the Jazz chord tones) and an octave of C1, C2 or C3.

features.name: Bass Synth
features.description: 8-voice Sine, Saw, Square or Triangle oscillator with ADSR and a one-pole low-pass from 100 to 2000 Hz.

features.name: Delay and Reverb
features.description: A 250 ms delay with fixed 30% feedback and a JUCE reverb, each with a 0-1 mix control.

features.name: MIDI Export
features.description: Writes the current pattern to a .mid file on channel 1 at 120 BPM.
